name: NBB Central Balance Sheet Office
aliases: National Bank of Belgium annual accounts
description: Belgian annual accounts from the Central Balance Sheet Office of the National Bank of Belgium (authentic data web service): list every annual account a company filed by enterprise number, read a filing's reference data, and fetch its accounting data as JSON-XBRL or XBRL or the published PDF. Read-only.
instructions:
## NBB Central Balance Sheet Office (CBSO)
This connector uses the **CBSO authentic data web service** of the National Bank of Belgium (`https://ws.cbso.nbb.be/authentic`): the annual accounts that Belgian companies and associations filed with the Central Balance Sheet Office and that the NBB accepted. Everything is read-only.

**Setup**
1. Subscribe to the CBSO web services (the subscription form on nbb.be, Central Balance Sheet Office, products); the NBB sends a CLIENT_ID for your technical user.
2. Sign up on the developer portal https://developer.cbso.nbb.be, open **Products**, subscribe to **NBB CBSO Web Services - Authentic Data** (the NBB approves the request) and copy the primary key from your profile into `NBB_CBSO_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY`. It is sent as the `NBB-CBSO-Subscription-Key` header.
3. Every call also carries an `X-Request-Id` (a version 4 UUID) for tracing; the tools fill one in, and you can pass your own `request_id`.

**Identifiers**
- Enterprise number: the 10-digit number in the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE), without dots or the BE prefix, e.g. `0203201340` (BE 0203.201.340 is the NBB itself).
- Reference number: the id of one filing (deposit), e.g. `2023-00123456`, from the `ReferenceNumber` field of the list.

**Workflow**
1. `nbb_cbso_list_annual_accounts` with the enterprise number (and `year` for one fiscal year): one entry per filing with ReferenceNumber, DepositDate, ExerciseDates (StartDate, EndDate), ModelType (full, abridged, micro, association models), DepositType (Initial or a correction), Language, Currency, company name, address, legal form, legal situation, activity code, general assembly date, AccountingDataURL and DataVersion.
2. `nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_reference` for the same reference data of one filing.
3. `nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_data` for the figures: JSON-XBRL by default (the rubric codes of the Belgian schema, e.g. 10/15 equity, 70 turnover, 9904 profit or loss of the period, 9087 average FTE workers) or XBRL. Only standardised accounts have this data; others exist only as PDF.
4. `nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_pdf` for the published document as a PDF file.

Take the latest filing of an exercise (a correction replaces the initial filing) and say which exercise dates the figures cover.

**Formats**: the API picks the format from the `Accept` header. JSON-XBRL (`application/x.jsonxbrl`) and XBRL (`application/x.xbrl`) can arrive as an attached file rather than inline text; the PDF always does. Large filings can exceed the attachment limit of 10 MB.

**Errors** come as problem JSON (`title`, `status`, `violations`): 400 a malformed enterprise or reference number or a year in the future, 401 a missing or wrong subscription key, 403 a key without an approved subscription to the authentic data product, 404 nothing found, 429 too many calls.

**Limitations**: the archive, extracts (daily batches as zip) and improved-data products of the NBB need separate subscriptions and are not exposed here. Companies exempt from publication have no public documents.
prerequisites: A subscription to the NBB CBSO web services and an approved subscription to the 'NBB CBSO Web Services - Authentic Data' product on developer.cbso.nbb.be, which gives the subscription key.

NBB_CBSO_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY.label: Subscription key
NBB_CBSO_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY.help: On developer.cbso.nbb.be: Profile, subscription to 'NBB CBSO Web Services - Authentic Data', primary key.
NBB_CBSO_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY.patternMessage: Paste the primary or secondary key of your Authentic Data subscription (letters and digits only).

verifyHints.401: The NBB refused the subscription key. Copy the primary key of your Authentic Data subscription from your profile on developer.cbso.nbb.be.
verifyHints.403: The key is valid, but its subscription does not cover the Authentic Data product, or the NBB has not approved it yet.

tools.name: nbb_cbso_list_annual_accounts
tools.description: List the annual accounts a Belgian company filed with the NBB Central Balance Sheet Office and the NBB accepted, by enterprise number. Each entry: ReferenceNumber, DepositDate, ExerciseDates (StartDate, EndDate), ModelType, DepositType (Initial or correction), Language, Currency, EnterpriseName, Address, LegalForm, LegalSituation, ActivityCode, GeneralAssemblyDate, AccountingDataURL, DataVersion. Start here; pass `year` for one fiscal year.

enterprise_number.description: 10-digit KBO/BCE enterprise number without dots or BE prefix, e.g. 0203201340.

year.description: Fiscal year (year of the exercise end date), not later than the current year. Omit for all filings.

request_id.description: Version 4 UUID sent as X-Request-Id for tracing; a default is filled in.

tools.name: nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_reference
tools.description: Get the reference data of one filed annual account by its reference number: deposit date, exercise dates, model type, deposit type, language, currency, company name, address, legal form, legal situation, activity code, general assembly date and data version.

reference_number.description: ReferenceNumber of the filing from nbb_cbso_list_annual_accounts, e.g. 2023-00123456.

request_id.description: Version 4 UUID sent as X-Request-Id for tracing; a default is filled in.

tools.name: nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_data
tools.description: Get the accounting data of one filed annual account: balance sheet, income statement, notes and social balance as JSON-XBRL (default) or XBRL, coded with the Belgian rubric codes (e.g. 10/15 equity, 70 turnover, 9904 profit or loss). Only standardised accounts have this data; for others use nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_pdf. The answer can arrive as an attached file.

reference_number.description: ReferenceNumber of the filing from nbb_cbso_list_annual_accounts.

request_id.description: Version 4 UUID sent as X-Request-Id for tracing; a default is filled in.

tools.name: nbb_cbso_get_annual_account_pdf
tools.description: Download the published annual account of one filing as a PDF file (the document as filed, or the NBB's PDF reproduction), attached to the result. Works for standardised and non-standardised accounts alike.

reference_number.description: ReferenceNumber of the filing from nbb_cbso_list_annual_accounts.

request_id.description: Version 4 UUID sent as X-Request-Id for tracing; a default is filled in.
